reused_results.scope: Exact thermal/all-free EOS and energy/count transfer; endpoint temperature difference

assumptions.statement: Finite nonnegative state with fixed event columns S and nonnegative rate functions; common event extent multiplies every state and ledger increment.

H nuclei, He nuclei, charge/e and kinetic+chemical+radiative energy rows annihilate S; positive active energies and nonnegative chemical/radiation energy conventions give a compact invariant state set.
N_thermal=N_H+N_He+N_e; N_H+N_He>0. Active electron counts are excluded from thermal EOS. All free electron representation uses the prior exact excess-energy state.

Proposal f_r(z;y_n)=kappa_r(T(z),fractions(z),selected target density(z),t_star)*B_r(y_n,V_star); initial donor factors are fixed during one solve and coefficient dependence is evaluated at candidate endpoint.

f_r(y_n;y_n)=physical_rate_r(y_n,t_star); every zero-capacity event disabled at initial support has vanishing physical rate there. Frozen zero-reactant proposals are defined as zero before any singular coefficient evaluation.
Coefficients are nonnegative and continuous on the named compact domain K for existence; finite Lipschitz or derivative bounds are supplied for unique fixed point and explicit contraction.
For U_n>0 choose T_floor=U_n/(2*c_v*N_max), T_ceiling=E_total/(c_v*N_min). Domain map condition h*C_U_proposal<=U_n. Additional positive density floors use corresponding retained donor bounds.

For U_n=0 use coefficients continuously defined at T=0; positive-temperature singular rate families use FP-A7. At zero electron density, existence via continuous extension and contraction via bounded derivatives are separate hypotheses.
Positive fixed state scales a_i define mixed-unit weighted infinity norm. Computed q<1 is required for unique fixed point, geometric Picard convergence and algebraic residual certificate.

Physical ODE rates locally Lipschitz in an open neighborhood of K, quasipositive at accessible nonnegative boundaries within that regular domain and preserve the same linear invariants; explicit state/time Lipschitz and speed bounds hold along the compared paths.
Physical ODE path inside positive-temperature box can be ensured by h*C_U_physical<=U_n/2 and analogous density conditions; linear reconstruction remains in convex K.

Expansion is prescribed and common to compared states. Collision-step certificate is multiplied by gamma=(V_plus/V_minus)^(-2/3) under a following exact thermal geometric substep. Full split accuracy uses its actual combined residual.

zero_population_handling.zero_negative_donor: Disable only incident consuming event for this step; denominator sums use fixed positive initial donor support.
zero_population_handling.zero_frozen_reactant: Set proposal to zero before coefficient evaluation.
zero_population_handling.species_group_absent: If N_H=0 or N_He=0 omit the corresponding fractions and reactions; no division by absent nuclei.
zero_population_handling.zero_thermal_energy: Use a regular rate family continuously defined at T=0 or a positive initial thermal energy domain.
zero_population_handling.zero_target_electron_density: For B(n)=K*n*log(C/sqrt(n)), positive coefficient and derivative domain is 0<n_lo<=n<=n_hi<C^2. The continuous n=0 extension supports existence when applicable; contraction uses positive density bounds or a regular rate family.
zero_population_handling.h_zero: Map equals initial state; no endpoint physical rate defect division by h is formed.
zero_population_handling.new_donor_created: Proposal support is rebuilt from the accepted state at the next step; its within-step reaction extent is O(h^2) under local Lipschitz rates.

formulas.sufficient_h_contraction: 2*q_target/(A+sqrt(A^2+4*B*q_target)) if B>0; q_target/A if B=0,A>0; unlimited if A=B=0

conditional_claims.statement: All capacity-map outputs and fixed-point iterates are nonnegative and preserve every declared linear event invariant exactly.
Explicit thermal/density bounds construct a compact invariant domain for continuous coefficient feedback and a fixed point exists.
Computable coefficient constants give q<1, unique endpoint on K and convergence of feasible Picard iterates.
Algebraic residual, evaluation error and approximate coefficient error give an endpoint and temperature certificate.

Under matching initial physical rates and zero-support compatibility, the frozen donor capacity step is first-order consistent and has a computable O(h^2) local difference from the continuous reaction ODE.
Actual endpoint vector-field defect plus state/time Lipschitz constants bounds the continuous ODE endpoint and temperature error by an explicit reconstruction integral.
Neutral one-event temperature/composition feedback fixture has an exact rational endpoint, global scalar contraction and a distinct exact physical time defect.
